summary.p1: I am a Software Analyst with experience in developing web and mobile applications, with a strong focus on security, authentication, and biometric-based solutions.
summary.p2: I have a solid technical background and hands-on experience with multiple programming languages and technologies, which allows me to quickly adapt to new environments, frameworks, and programming languages.
summary.p3: I work with an approach oriented toward best development practices, modular architecture, system scalability, continuous integration (CI/CD), and user experience.
summary.p4: Through my academic and professional background, I am able to design, implement, and maintain solutions using different programming languages and paradigms, efficiently incorporating new technologies and ecosystems.
